settings_terminal_shell_atlas_could_not_: Atlas could not read your shell
settings_terminal_shell_atlas_runs_this_: Atlas runs this to learn your PATH.
settings_terminal_shell_full_path_to_a_s: Full path to a shell not listed.
settings_terminal_shell_reloaded: Shell reloaded. Stop and start running projects to use it.
settings_terminal_shell_tools_such_as_bu: Tools such as bun or node may not be found. Pick another shell, or fix the error below in your shell startup files, then reload.
settings_terminal_shell_your_projects_on: Your projects only see the basic system PATH
settings_terminal_tab_clicking_on_the_pr: Clicking on the prompt line moves the cursor there. Needs shell integration (OSC 133 prompt marks); fast terminal only.
settings_terminal_tab_draw_text_slightly: Draw text slightly heavier. Helps thin fonts on dark backgrounds.
settings_terminal_tab_draws_local_termin: Draws local terminals on the graphics chip for smoother scrolling and faster output. Applies to terminals you open afterwards. SSH terminals always use the classic renderer.
settings_terminal_tab_font_families_in_o: Font families in order, like a CSS list. The first one installed wins, else JetBrains Mono. Variable fonts work.
settings_terminal_tab_how_the_cursor_loo: How the cursor looks in terminals.
settings_terminal_tab_join_characters_li: Join characters like -> and != into single symbols. Fast terminal only.
settings_terminal_tab_lets_commands_such: Lets commands, such as tmux or a remote shell, put text on your clipboard.
settings_terminal_tab_lightens_or_darken: Lightens or darkens text that is hard to read on its background. 4.5 (the default) meets WCAG AA; 1 turns it off. Fast terminal only.
settings_terminal_tab_lines_of_output_ea: Lines of output each terminal remembers. More lines use more memory.
settings_terminal_tab_most_memory_one_te: Most memory one terminal spends on its scrollback. A wide terminal keeps fewer lines than the setting above to stay inside it (fast terminal only).
settings_terminal_tab_option_as_alt_desc: Makes the {@common_os_alt_key} key send Alt ({key} jumps back a word) instead of typing a macOS character such as ∫. Fast terminal only.
settings_terminal_tab_programs_can_copy_: Programs can copy to your clipboard
settings_terminal_tab_restart_host_body: Running terminals and agents end. Tabs stay; use Restart on each to reopen them.
settings_terminal_tab_selecting_text_cop: Selecting text copies it to the clipboard as soon as you release the mouse.
settings_terminal_tab_space_above_and_be: Space above and below the text. The margin uses the terminal background.
settings_terminal_tab_space_left_and_rig: Space left and right of the text. The margin uses the terminal background.
settings_terminal_tab_the_background_pro: The background process that keeps terminals alive. Restart it to pick up a new Atlas version; running terminals end.
settings_terminal_tab_the_running_termin: The running terminal host is from an older Atlas, so terminals use the classic renderer.
settings_terminal_worktree_preview_capti: New worktrees go here, on the branch {#code}{branch}{/code}.
settings_terminal_worktree_preview_where: Where the next worktree is created
